scientific_integrity: The 2024 determinant reduction and 2026 independence-number theorem are acknowledged as antecedents. Same-model proof review only; no independent validation or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only finite commutative chain rings with nonzero square-zero maximal ideal; no claim for non-chain rings, longer radicals, or higher matrix sizes. Full polynomial proved intrinsically, not inferred from finite experiments. Publication priority subject to independent literature review.
title: Exact independence polynomial of triangular commuting graphs over radical-square-zero chain rings
